services.desc: Join us for a rejuvenating evening of yoga on June 20th at 6pm at the Salt Lake Art Museum! Led by certified yoga instructor Hallie Jensen, this 1 hour session will guide you through thoughtful movement and breath to help you find balance, strength, and inner calm. Hallie brings her passion for connecting the body and mind and creating a welcoming space for all levels. Don’t forget to bring your mat!
